description.p: kyrr removes background noise from your microphone for every app, and types what you say into any window. Everything runs on your computer: no cloud, no account, no telemetry.
kyrr entfernt Störgeräusche von deinem Mikrofon, für jede App, und tippt, was du sagst, in jedes Fenster. Alles läuft auf deinem Computer: keine Cloud, kein Konto, keine Telemetrie.

ul.li: Neural noise suppression (DPDFNet) on a virtual microphone that becomes the default
Neuronale Entfernung von Störgeräuschen (DPDFNet) auf einem virtuellen Mikrofon, das zum Standard wird
Voice shaping: sound, compressor, softer S sounds, pop protection, automatic volume
Stimme: Klang, Kompressor, weichere S-Laute, Popschutz, automatische Lautstärke
Dictation in German, English and more European languages: hold a key, speak, release
Diktieren auf Deutsch, Englisch und weiteren europäischen Sprachen: Taste halten, sprechen, loslassen
Level check, a before/after test and listening to yourself
Pegelanzeige, Vorher/Nachher-Test und Mithören

description.p: The speech model (about 700 to 900 MB) is downloaded once on first use.
Das Sprachmodell (etwa 700 bis 900 MB) wird beim ersten Diktieren einmal heruntergeladen.

screenshot.caption: Noise filter, voice and dictation, each with one switch

ul.li: Voice memos with F8, a list and one-click text
Setup in three steps, with a Lean or Best quality setting for slower computers
The wave writes the words smoothly, and they show sooner on slower computers
Distance compensation is on by default
The first words after starting kyrr are no longer lost
A Feedback button in Settings, About
Dictation in more European languages: "Multilingual" next to German and English
The wave shows the words kyrr has heard while you dictate
New to try: an option for speaking far from the microphone
A calmer dictation wave that follows your system's light or dark style
On Hyprland, dictated text keeps its spaces in browser text fields
A small wave at the bottom of the screen shows while you dictate
Dictation runs up to 15 minutes at a stretch
On Hyprland, kyrr from the tray opens as a floating window and the second dictation comes out right
Letters your keyboard layout does not have, like umlauts on a US keyboard, are typed into the window by themselves
The window's close button minimizes kyrr every time, and going back to simple settings makes the window smaller again
On Hyprland, Sway, river and niri kyrr sets up the dictation key and the start at sign-in itself; on GNOME 46 and 47 it adds the key to GNOME's keyboard shortcuts
"Set up PipeWire" installs PipeWire where it is missing
Clearer messages where kyrr needs your help
First release for Linux: a microphone of its own called "kyrr" with the noise removed, and dictation into any window
On GNOME and KDE kyrr walks you through the key and the permission to type
kyrr follows the microphone you plug in or pick in the sound settings
